original_intensity_CT.note: The selected18um binary segmentation is sufficient to define the requested void/material domain. Raw intensity DICOMs are not present in this cloud workspace; this audit does not claim they are irretrievably unavailable.

native_surface_topology.conclusion: A watertight consistently oriented2-manifold PLC candidate. Existing audits do not certify an embedded nonintersecting cavity complex suitable for immediate constrained tetrahedralization.

strict_original_boundary_lower_bounds.derivation: A connected face-adjacency spanning tree starts with4vertices in the first tet; every additional tet shares a triangular face and introduces at most1new vertex. Thus V<=T+3.
strict_original_boundary_lower_bounds.note: At least33M is a lower threshold, not a maximum. The original boundary already forces at least37.95M tetrahedra and may require far more for valid quality and thin features.

memory_storage_estimates.basis_for_matrix_estimate: Counts only boundary adjacency: diagonalblocksV + directededgeblocks2E,9Float64values per3x3block. Actual volume mesh adds interior edges and nodes. Full BSR is18.60GiB; existing SciPy scalar CSR64 graph is35.83GiB before AMG and most other data. These are storage-model estimates, not universal bounds for every possible matrix-free algorithm.

suggested_full_boundary_HPC_initial_budg.confidence: Engineering planning estimate only; perform a representative meshing pilot and measure peak memory before requesting production resources.

current_solver_limits.implementation: Serial Python/NumPy P1 element assembly into SciPy CSR, CG with PyAMG smoothed aggregation and6rigid-motion candidates
current_solver_limits.geometry: Closed-solid L0 proxy with local apical refinement; original native voids omitted
current_solver_limits.why_not_native33M_claim: Surface projection never introduces the missing native pore geometry into the solved domain. Existing numerical fields are not a porous33Mtet result.

recommended_execution_plan: Freeze original18um segmentation and native surface hashes; preserve every original low-density void boundary and positive material domain.
Run global self-intersection and shell-containment checks using robust predicates; obtain strictly interior seeds for every excluded cavity from the original mask, without hole filling or smoothing.

Generate a constrained tetrahedral mesh from the native PLC with TetGen/Gmsh or a distributed mesher, preserving boundary facets or only explicitly recorded conforming subdivision; adapt interior sizing and refine narrow ligaments and stress regions. Do not prepromise a33Mcap.
Verify positive Jacobians, nonoverlap, exact boundary conformity, material/void occupancy and integrated volume; compare directly with the original segmentation.

Partition and solve50mm and100mm cases independently using a distributed PETSc block or matrix-free elasticity implementation with a verified scalable preconditioner. Record actual nodes, tetrahedra, loads, constraints and units.
Treat boundary-adjacent tetrahedra and interior material as display selections on one volumetric mesh. If original voids are intentionally filled, record a distinct geometry and rerun its mechanics.
Evaluate tip and support-region convergence on fixed physical ROIs and prescribed tolerances; source model count or algebraic residual alone is not convergence evidence.
